name: Multi-Tile Orchestration Pilot
author: GitHub Copilot (GPT-5.1-Codex)
objectives: Demonstrate contract algebra by chaining multiple tiles in a single proof path
Propagate constraint context, capability bindings, and pressure telemetry across tile hops
Produce ledger-ready evidence (proofs, alerts, presentation facts) for multi-tile executions

constraints_alignment.I1: Deterministic resolver graph evaluation and tile execution order
constraints_alignment.I2: Explicit work-unit accounting per tile with bounded resource budgets
constraints_alignment.I3: Schema-backed governance artifacts (component index, proofs, alerts)
constraints_alignment.I4: JSON-first documentation + renderer manifests fed by chained outputs

tile_chain_blueprint.future_extension: Enable resolver to infer capability chains from tile contracts (no manual capability_plan) and inject additional tiles (e.g., grounding, summarization) via declarative execution plans

delivery_phases.name: Phase A: Resolver Graph Semantics
tasks: Extend Goal to optionally declare ordered capability chains (capability_plan: List[str])
Add resolver graph planner that maps capability_plan entries to TileContracts via registry
Persist full TileInvocation sequences in ProofRecord.tile_sequence with hop metadata
Document follow-on work to auto-infer capability chains from goal desired_output + tile dependencies

delivery_phases.name: Phase B: Tile Execution Pipeline
tasks: Allow resolver to feed outputs from stage N as facts into stage N+1 (preserve constraints_compliance)
Normalize multi-output facts (list) for downstream tiles, including AlertPanelTile alerts input
Emit deterministic work metrics per tile and attach to resource_usage as hop-specific entries
Define proof + substrate semantics for partial-failure chains (successful hops recorded, downstream hops marked rejected)
success_metrics: Downstream tile receives upstream fact payload

delivery_phases.name: Phase C: Multi-Hop Pressure + Ledger
tasks: Evaluate pressure per tile, record per-hop usage entries, and compute aggregate metrics (max_ratio, total_operation_units)
Propagate most severe signal into proof.resource_usage.pressure_state while preserving hop provenance
Update ledger_metadata.pressure_signal to capture multi-hop context (tile_id + hop index)
Generate presentation views for each hop (route_decision, dispatch, alert_panel, etc.)
success_metrics: pressure_alert ledger entries reference hop tile_id

delivery_phases.name: Phase D: Test + Governance Automation
tasks: Author integration tests covering success + failure chains (missing fact mid-chain, capability mismatch)
Use component_registry_sync to refresh component index entries for touched tiles
Update knowledge base techniques/automation entries with lessons learned

manual_inspection: ProofRecord JSON ensuring tile_sequence aligns with capability plan

risks.description: Resolver graph planner may allow cycles or unordered execution
risks.mitigation: Enforce acyclic capability_plan validation + max hop count

risks.description: Aggregating pressure across hops could hide local overloads
risks.mitigation: Record per-hop pressure signals and compute max + cumulative ratios

next_actions: Schedule Phase A implementation in src/runtime/resolver.py
Design integration tests for multi-hop success/failure scenarios
Implement and document tile.reasoning.route_dispatch, then coordinate with governance automation to auto-register the new tile
